# Delta Institute

> Delta Institute delivers immersive career development and college preparation programs for high school students through virtual work experience, mentorship, and skill-building initiatives.

Delta Institute offers multiple pathways for students to explore careers, develop professional skills, and prepare for university admissions. Programs range from 4-week career discovery experiences to 8-week mentored projects with industry experts and Ivy League professionals, complemented by specialized bootcamps in AI, coding, and international diplomacy.

## Core Programs

- [Programs Overview](https://www.deltainstitute.co/programs): Delta Careers virtual work experience programs with global companies
- [Discover Program](https://www.deltainstitute.co/discover-program): 4-week career exploration with coaching and CliftonStrengths assessment
- [Deepen Program](https://www.deltainstitute.co/deepen-program): 8-week 1:1 mentorship with Ivy League and industry mentors on expert-led projects
- [Delta Launch](https://www.deltainstitute.co/deltalaunch): College admissions preparation with AI and coding bootcamps
- [UN Pathways Immersion: Geneva](https://www.deltainstitute.co/un-pathways-hybrid): International diplomacy immersion program for UN and global affairs expertise
